text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Would you like to have some tea with me, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: When I went back to my parents' house over break, we drank this tea with a positively wonderful aroma. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's very relaxing and helps you sleep at night. I highly recommend it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Then, let's have a delightful teatime! I'll go boil some water.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like Satono Diamond had a great time on her day off!
